title: design/link.md Measuring phase and Checking with a DAW; run the checklist and post the numbers on the initiative
description:
## Intent
Write the manual DAW checklist into the design note and run the whole of it once both harnesses pass, as the initiative's final check.

## Steps
1. `design/link.md` "Checking with a DAW": the steps from the M2 and M3 manual tasks (apricitus-640c7a, apricitus-b1f287) as one checklist, with what "pass" sounds like.
2. `design/link.md` "Measuring phase": how the harnesses work, the report fields, how to read a failure.
3. Run the checklist natively and in Chrome with the current build; record results.
4. Post the numbers from both harness reports and the checklist results as a comment on the initiative apricitus-2e6ec4.

## Verify
A comment on apricitus-2e6ec4 with: native max/p99, browser max/p99, the checklist outcome, versions. The reviewer re-runs both harness commands.

Commit: `docs(<this task id>)`.

## Protocol
Specs first, watched red; log decisions, problems and outcomes with `kbs comment`; run Verify and paste the tail. Every Bash call starts `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH && cd /Users/home/Projects/Apricity`; cargo with `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 RUST_TEST_THREADS=2` under `safe-run.sh --`. Never change dependencies to make a build pass. Sub-agents never commit, push or close.
